nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to defense or making risky attacks. Do not neglect scouting to detect tech switches or early pressure.

opening.opening_summary: A Terran opening that prioritizes economic and technological development while maintaining a flexible, ground-oriented posture. Early scouting with Reaper is common, and the build aims to transition into a heavy production and tech-heavy midgame.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a strong economy and technology base while preserving flexibility to adapt to Protoss tech choices and pressure.
